excerpts.selection: Only public-source findings relevant to this Ram supplement; unrelated analyses and local document paths omitted.

findings.observed: NADA2010 Inventory Planner printed pp1 and4 combines sales forecasts, desired stock, on-hand inventory, transit and commitments; recommends model/configuration history, lost-sales review, regional comparison and weekly reassessment. Order ratings permit build, maintain or no stock orders.
findings.limits: Recommended practice, not empirical proof every dealer follows it. Suggested45days adaptable, not universal. Source days-supply parenthetical omits a time conversion; do not copy it as a dimensionally correct formula.

findings.observed: vAuto defines market days supply as market units of an exact configuration divided by average daily retail sales over preceding45days.
findings.limits: Current vendor method, not proof STLA dealers used this exact method in2024. Sales rate depends on price and availability, not pure latent preference. CRM leads/appointments/deposits useful candidate forward signals, not verified here as universal ordering inputs.

findings.finding: Published model-sales table measures end-customer deliveries including fleet; dealer purchases feed wholesale shipments and inventory, not mechanically the same series. Simplified receipts = customer deliveries + change in dealer stock, adjusting transfers and timing. Orders precede receipts and need not be fulfilled.
findings.hypothetical: 20 customer sales plus inventory falling60to45 implies5 receipts, ignoring other movements. Stable customer sales can coexist with lower wholesale shipments.
